question: Should this release remove the 37 shipped root skills and make Sherpa ONNX TTS an official ClawHub-only plugin despite the required user migration and new artifact-trust contract?
rationale: The implementation direction is technically coherent, but deleting shipped capabilities, choosing the official package source, and accepting native download trust are product and release contracts that automation cannot authorize.

options.title: Land after migration and trust proof
options.body: Publish verified replacements, add upgrade recovery for persisted skill names, authorize the current dependency graph, and prove Sherpa package and artifact availability before merge.

options.title: Split Sherpa from the trim
options.body: Land the narrower Sherpa packaging work after trust approval while parking the broad bundled-skill removal until its migration plan is ready.

options.title: Accept the compatibility break
options.body: Intentionally remove the shipped skills with explicit release communication and support ownership, accepting that existing configured capabilities may disappear.

recommendation.title: Land after migration and trust proof
recommendation.body: Publish verified replacements, add upgrade recovery for persisted skill names, authorize the current dependency graph, and prove Sherpa package and artifact availability before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the merged split-work context, is assigned here, and has already defined which decisions remain in this broad PR.
